aircraft.description: Installed aircraft id; its pack must carry a `preflight` section.

covers_on.description: Covers, ropes, and chocks are fitted when the lesson starts.

random_findings.description: Findings to seed at random from the pack's seedable defects.

runway_end.description: Runway end the aircraft is parked at.

seed.description: Seed for random findings. The same seed always seeds the same findings.

spot.description: Where the aircraft stands. Default: the ramp beside the runway.

DefectKind.description: Findings an instructor or lesson can seed. The first three are physical props left on.

ParkingSpot.description:
Where on the airport the aircraft stands. The region data carries runways, not aprons or
taxiways, so spots are placed from the real runway geometry (threshold and heading), not
surveyed: close enough to practise on, not a chart of the airport.

oneOf.description: Parked on the apron beside the runway, facing it (cold and dark, pre-flight, securing).
The run-up area beside the runway end, heading along the runway.
Holding short of the runway end, facing the runway.
